cause: runTen stopped at zero HP before the ordinary four-second respawn delay, and held the pre-restore entity reference. The solid-tank trajectory exposed this during a legal Mega-fight death.
fix: Continue ordinary world updates while dead, and fetch entity 1 each tick after checkpoint restoration.
regression: Zero-HP frame advances; respawned entity replaces the original and contributes movement metrics on the next frame.
